description: This file defines a utility class GuarantorEnumerations that provides methods to convert GuarantorType and GuarantorFundStatusType enum values into EnumOptionData objects, catering to different input types such as integers and enum instances. It also offers a method to convert an array of GuarantorType enums into a list of EnumOptionData.

classes.name: GuarantorEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert guarantor-related enums into EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: guarantorType (int id)
methods.description: Converts an integer ID into an EnumOptionData object for GuarantorType.

methods.name: guarantorType (GuarantorType guarantorType)
methods.description: Converts a GuarantorType enum instance into an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: guarantorType (GuarantorType[] guarantorTypes)
methods.description: Converts an array of GuarantorType enums into a list of EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: guarantorFundStatusType (int id)
methods.description: Converts an integer ID into an EnumOptionData object for GuarantorFundStatusType.

methods.name: guarantorFundStatusType (GuarantorFundStatusType guarantorFundType)
methods.description: Converts a GuarantorFundStatusType enum instance into an EnumOptionData object.
